title: ARDS, high drive on short-Ti VC: double trigger
summary: Neural Ti 1.3 s against a 0.4 s machine breath. The effort persists past cycle-off, re-triggers the ventilator, and stacks two tidal volumes; Paw is scooped by flow starvation.
objectives: Spot the stacked breath: a second trigger before exhalation is complete and a doubled volume.
Fix it by matching machine Ti to neural Ti (Ti or flow pattern), raising flow, or in PSV/PC lengthening the breath; sedation is the last resort.
